newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa begins new painted steel operations.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa begins new painted steel operations.

text.p: Mexican steel company Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) began operations at a new painting plant for galvanized steel, the company said on Monday.
The plant's products will increase the company's margins, "given that national and international prices of the products are among the (company's) highest," Ahmsa said.
Ahmsa said the painted products are used in the automobile industry, in construction and for furniture, among other areas. ((-- Daniel Perez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau +528 345-7617))
